name: Qosic

spans: Our payment link allows individuals or businesses to easily receive payments from people anywhere.
Nom de votre application ou entreprise

open_questions: qosic.com says individuals can receive payments with its payment link, but neither qosic.com (home, /pricing, /terms-and-conditions, /merchant-service-agreement, /support) nor docs.qosic.com (account creation, go-live checklist, go-live) says whether an individual without a registered business can get API access, nor which documents the merchant onboarding asks for.

description: Qosic (QOSPAY) is a West African payment aggregator for mobile money collection, disbursement and card checkout. This spec set covers Togo (Togocel / Yas and Moov Togo). Qosic also supports Benin (MTN, Moov, Celtiis) and card payments via a separate Checkout product not covered here.
example_prompt: Add Qosic / QOSPAY to my Togolese app so I can collect mobile money payments from Togocel and Moov customers and disburse payouts to mobile money numbers.
